After optimization, the final skill library ℳ ∗ \mathcal{M}^{*} is fixed and shared across all test tasks. For each task goal g g , retrieval builds ℰ \mathcal{E} once before interaction begins, and the prompt then holds the task goal, the library, and the retrieved demonstrations ( Figure 2 b). The task goal g g is available to both the retrieval planner and the agent, while the retrieved demonstrations carry no goals of their own. At each step, the agent predicts an action with Equation 1 , executes it, observes the resulting page, and extends its history, while the library and demonstrations stay fixed. TeleTune therefore adapts at two levels. Skill optimization learns global knowledge that transfers across tasks, and workflow-based retrieval assembles local evidence to cover subgoals of the current task.

items.title: TeleTune: Evolving Agent Skills From Offline Telemetry
items.feedback: Offline next-action prediction errors propose edits; mean dev-split action-prediction accuracy compares candidate and incumbent and accepts only improvement. Live environment success is measured later, not used during optimization.
items.persistence: Accepted libraries are checkpointed and used in subsequent optimization; the final fixed library is shared across all test tasks and seeds.
items.why_zh: 修改的是放入Agent提示的跨实例操作流程和决策规则；离线错误与dev评分驱动编辑并接受版本，冻结后在新任务复用。评估反馈满足判据，无需将离线代理指标误称为在线执行反馈。

items.summary_numbers_applicability: 现有正式摘要为null。本次不创作带数字摘要。源中77.1/80.6成功率与6.7/7.7差值同时见两版表1；Online-Mind2Web按文中剔除CAPTCHA的discounted success口径。5–75倍少token是对验证相同候选所需live episodes的估计，非真实同预算端到端成本对照。
limitations: Optimization uses teacher-forced recorded actions, not live environment execution.
Training-time inferred goals use entire trajectories, though prompts forbid action-sequence descriptions.
Test-time input token cost increases; no universal cost-matched superiority claim.

items.title: EmbodiedEvo: Self-Evolving Coding Agent For Physical Intelligence
items.feedback: Persistent Playground code editing, execution and physical-state feedback revise Skills and Lessons; failures can add applicable recovery conditions as well as successful routines.
items.persistence: Skills/Lessons are frozen as read-only artifacts; unseen scenes begin with fresh agents, workspaces and simulators; cross-model and separately scoped cross-task reuse are evaluated.
items.why_zh: 保留可执行Skills及适用条件，与单次场景中临时修代码分开；Playground反馈修改后冻结，新场景新Agent读取同一工件。Lessons只是互补，纳入依据是复用代码技能机制。

items.summary_numbers_applicability: 现有正式摘要为null。本次不创作带数字摘要。44.48 Score /37.82% SR为full set一次seed；+8.86/+5.50是固定Sol/Luna执行器相对无经验的SR百分点，53.0%为Test费用相对Raw History（排除Playground），不是相对无经验的节省，也不是token减少；tokens减少另为11.3%。两版表及这些对应正文保持。
limitations: Full-set result uses one seed; paired mechanism studies use five scenes per task.
Skills/Lessons cost is higher than No Experience; savings compare Raw History only.
Successful paired traces do not isolate the causal effect of one artifact.
Precision failures and negative transfer remain in scope evidence.
